in_telugu.name: నవరాఙ్గ
in_telugu.long_meaning: యూథోపీఠ యేశజీభేద యొజనాళేజేశ యొజనాళేశ యోజనాళేశయోజనేశ యోజనేశ (nava rasalu, nine rasas)

in_marathi.name: Navrang
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Nine forms, colors, or emotions
in_marathi.long_meaning: Navrang हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Navrang refers to the nine fundamental emotions or rasas in Hindu philosophy. These emotions are Sringar (love), Hasya (laughter), Raudra (anger), Karuna (compassion), Veer (heroism), Adbhut (wonder), Shantha (peace), Bibhatsa (fear), and Shoka (sorrow).
